visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The First Element Is Never Compared
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 12 11 13 5 6 should be sorted to [5, 6, 11, 12, 13], but the program prints [12, 5, 6, 11, 13].

solution.explanation: Index 0 is a valid element that may have to move too. The condition must allow j to reach 0 (j >= 0); with j > 0 the first element is never compared and never shifted.
